title: French-Style Beef in Peanut Sauce
description: A French twist on the classic Filipino dish, with tender beef in a rich and nutty peanut sauce. Serve with steamed vegetables and crusty bread for a hearty meal.

ingredients.name: kare-kare peanut sauce mix
ingredients.notes: available at Asian markets or online

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of peanut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of peanut oil.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the peanut butter until smooth.
Add the kare-kare peanut sauce mix and stir to combine.
Add the beef broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Return the beef to the skillet and cook until heated through.
Season with sugar to balance the flavors.
Serve hot over steamed vegetables or rice.
